final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Pods listing in boutique shows a single outlier: emailservice-68b7cdc49b-9fnrq READY 1/1 Running with RESTARTS 2 (25s ago) at only 90s age, while all other 10 pods have 0 restarts. Pod events bind the mechanism verbatim: 'Warning Unhealthy Liveness probe failed: Get http://172.20.1.99:8080/: net/http: HTTP/1.x transport connection broken: malformed HTTP response' followed by 'Normal Killing Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted' (x3 in 61s). The returned bytes (\x00\x00\x1e\x04 ...) are an HTTP/2 SETTINGS frame, proving the container speaks gRPC/HTTP2 on 8080. GetAppYAML(emailservice) confirms the defect at config level: livenessProbe uses httpGet path=/ port=8080, while readinessProbe correctly uses grpc port=8080 and succeeds (Ready True, ContainersReady True). Port is not the fault: containerPort 8080, PORT=8080, Declared Port 8080/TCP, and the grpc readiness probe on the same port passes. Exit code 137 is NOT OOMKilled (Last State Reason: Error, not OOMKilled) - it is kubelet's SIGKILL after the liveness failure; GetErrorLogs(emailservice) reports no error logs and GetAlerts shows no active metric anomalies; image pull (already present), scheduling to worker-01 and ServiceAccount emailservice are all normal; namespace events empty.
